scope: Explicit PSF channel / authored Synth display and keyboard selection, with read-only imported ADPCM preview.

behavior.selector: View / keyboard: Synth - edit and play, or PSF CH 1..24. Selecting a CH or its activity number returns to observation/paused audition and enables Live if necessary. The remembered native CH is retained independently of Synth selection.
behavior.capture: Capture copies one channel into the authored editor, selects Synth without turning Live Off, retains the same Pause position and all 24 frozen activity values, and clears the CH selection highlight. Resume continues the source without replacing the captured editor sound.
behavior.liveToggle: Explicit Live Off selects Synth and stops observation acquisition; On returns to the remembered PSF channel. Selecting Synth alone preserves Live acquisition and activity.
behavior.ordinaryEdits: Actual instrument edits/imports and Code start continue to stop the source song.

preview.source: Original immutable ADPCM bytes, with zero initial predictor history at sample start. Capture / VAB Tone / preset supported.
preview.cache: WeakMap keyed by source byte object; no full RAM reads and no change to audio process/render.
preview.priority: Editable original PCM and Morph retain their existing canvas. Noise, host PCM and PMON support samples are excluded. Preview failure remains display-only.
preview.canvasReset: Explicitly clear an earlier ADPCM drawing when transitioning to an unassigned channel, host PCM or unavailable preview.

safety.method: Every headless destination is intercepted before application scripts through gain 0; Chromium also uses --mute-audio.

node.audioUnchanged: Preview enabled/disabled yields bit-exact next-render PCM, unchanged native frame counter, RAM, instrument and original ADPCM.
